name: Hilkiah
description: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: In his eighteenth year he sends Shaphan the scribe to Hilkiah the priest to gather the silver brought to the house of the Most High and deliver it to the workmen for repairs.

note.label: 2 Kings 22: Josiah and the Book of the Law

points: Hilkiah the high priest finds the book of the law in the house of the Most High and gives it to Shaphan, who reads it. Manasseh and Amon were so wicked the very book of the law had been lost.

note.label: 2 Kings 22: Josiah and the Book of the Law

points: Shaphan reports to the king about the money and the workmen, then tells him Hilkiah delivered him a book, and reads it before the king.

note.label: 2 Kings 22: Josiah and the Book of the Law

points: Hilkiah and the king's men go to Huldah the prophetess, who dwells in Jerusalem in the college; there were women among the people who were prophetesses, known by their works.

note.label: 2 Kings 22: Josiah and the Book of the Law

points: The king commanded Hilkiah and the priests to bring out of the temple all the vessels made for Baal, for the grove, and for all the host of heaven, and he burned them in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: Josiah also put away the workers with familiar spirits, the wizards, the images, the idols, and all the abominations spied in Judah and Jerusalem, that he might perform the words of the law found by Hilkiah.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: When they bring out the money, Hilkiah the priest finds a book of the law of the Lord given by Moses, the very Bible, and delivers it to Shaphan the scribe.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law

points: When the king hears the words of the law, he rends his clothes and commands Hilkiah, Ahikam, Abdon, Shaphan, and Asaiah to go inquire of the Lord for him and for the remnant left in Israel and Judah.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law

points: Hilkiah and the men go to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum, who dwells in the college in Jerusalem, and she declares the word of the Lord God of Israel.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law
